RecordingStartTime.description_en: The screen recording start time in the format of HH:MM:SS. This parameter is meaningful only when Recording is set to PERIOD
RecordingStartTime.description_zh: 录屏开始时间，取值：HH:MM:SS。只有Recording取值是PERIOD时，该返回值有实际意义

RecordingUserNotify.description_en: The client notification feature for screen recording
RecordingUserNotify.description_zh: 录屏客户端消息通知功能

RecordingUserNotifyMessage.description_en: The notification content for the screen recording client. Leave this parameter empty by default
RecordingUserNotifyMessage.description_zh: 录屏客户端通知内容。默认无需填写
RecordingUserNotifyMessage.example: 您的云电脑正在被录屏

RemoteCoordinate.description_en: The keyboard and mouse control permission for remote assistance
RemoteCoordinate.description_zh: 远程协助键鼠控制权限

ResetDesktop.description_en: The setting for resetting the cloud computer

ResolutionDpi.description_en: The DPI value of the screen resolution
ResolutionDpi.description_zh: 屏幕分辨率的 DPI 值

ResolutionHeight.description_en: The height of the resolution. Unit: pixels. Valid values for cloud applications: 500 to 50000. Valid values for cloud computers: 480 to 4096
ResolutionHeight.description_zh: 分辨率的高度。单位：像素。云应用取值范围：500\~50000， 云电脑取值范围：480\~4096

ResolutionWidth.description_en: The width of the resolution. Unit: pixels. Valid values for cloud applications: 500 to 50000. Valid values for cloud computers: 640 to 4096
ResolutionWidth.description_zh: 分辨率的宽度。单位：像素。云应用取值范围：500\~50000， 云电脑取值范围：640\~4096

ResourceGroupCount.description_en: The number of resource groups associated with the policy
ResourceGroupCount.description_zh: 已关联该策略的资源组数量

ResourceRegionId.description_en:
The region to which the cloud computer policy belongs.

If the policy is a region-independent policy, this value is `center`
ResourceRegionId.description_zh:
云电脑策略所属的地域。

若为无地域策略，则该值为`center`

SafeMenu.description_en:
The security center shortcut key switch. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
SafeMenu.description_zh:
安全中心快捷键开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Scope.description_en: The effective scope of the policy

ScopeValue.description_en: This parameter is required when `Scope` is set to `IP`. This parameter takes effect only when `Scope` is set to `IP`
ScopeValue.description_zh: `Scope`取值为`IP`的时候填写。当`Scope`为`IP`时生效，否则不生效

SmoothEnhancement.description_en: Specifies whether smoothness enhancement is enabled for daily office scenarios
SmoothEnhancement.description_zh: 日常办公场景选择，是否开启平滑度增强

StatusMonitor.description_en: Specifies whether the status monitoring entry is provided in the cloud computer floating ball
StatusMonitor.description_zh: 是否在云电脑悬浮球内提供状态监控功能入口

StreamingMode.description_en: The streaming mode for scenario adaptation

TargetFps.description_en: The target frame rate. Valid values: 10 to 60

ThreeScreen.description_en:
Specifies whether the three-screen feature is enabled. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
ThreeScreen.description_zh:
三屏开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

DeviceClass.description_en: The device class. This parameter is required when `usbRuleType` is set to 1. See Defined Class Codes (https://www.usb.org/defined-class-codes)
DeviceClass.description_zh: 设备类别，当`usbRuleType`为1的时候需要填写。参见Defined Class Codes (https://www.usb.org/defined-class-codes)

DeviceSubclass.description_en: The device subclass. This parameter is required when `usbRuleType` is set to 1. See Defined Class Codes (https://www.usb.org/defined-class-codes)
DeviceSubclass.description_zh: 设备子类别，当`usbRuleType`为1的时候需要填写。参见Defined Class Codes (https://www.usb.org/defined-class-codes)

VendorId.description_en: The vendor ID. See Valid USB Vendor IDs (VIDs) (https://www.usb.org/sites/default/files/vendor_ids032322.pdf_1.pdf)
VendorId.description_zh: 生产厂商ID。参见Valid USB Vendor IDs (VIDs) (https://www.usb.org/sites/default/files/vendor_ids032322.pdf_1.pdf)

UseTime.description_en:
Specifies whether the usage duration display on the floating ball is enabled. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
UseTime.description_zh:
悬浮球使用时长显示开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

VideoEncAvgKbps.description_en: The average bitrate for video encoding. Valid values: 1000 to 50000
VideoEncAvgKbps.description_zh: 视频编码平均码率，取值范围：1000\~50000

VideoEncMaxQP.description_en: The maximum QP for video encoding, which represents the lowest image quality. Valid values: 0 to 51
VideoEncMaxQP.description_zh: 视频编码最大QP，画面最低质量，取值范围：0\~51

VideoEncMinQP.description_en: The minimum QP for video encoding, which represents the highest quality. Valid values: 0 to 51
VideoEncMinQP.description_zh: 视频编码最小QP，最高质量。取值范围：0\~51

VideoEncPeakKbps.description_en: The peak bitrate for video encoding. Valid values: 1000 to 50000
VideoEncPeakKbps.description_zh: 视频编码峰值码率，取值范围：1000\~50000

WatermarkAntiCam.description_en: The anti-camera capture feature for invisible watermarks

WatermarkColor.description_en: The watermark font color. Valid values: 0 to 16777215
WatermarkColor.description_zh: 水印字体颜色。 取值范围： 0\~16777215

WatermarkCustomText.description_en: If the `WatermarkType` parameter is set to `custom`, you must also specify the custom text content by using the `WatermarkCustomText` parameter
WatermarkCustomText.description_zh: 若参数`WatermarkType`传入`custom`，则必须同时通过参数`WatermarkCustomText`传入自定义文本的内容

WatermarkDegree.description_en: The watermark tilt angle. Valid values: -10 to -30

WatermarkFontSize.description_en: The watermark font size. Valid values: 10 to 20
WatermarkFontSize.description_zh: 水印字体大小。 取值范围：10\~20

WatermarkPower.description_en: The enhancement feature for invisible watermarks

WatermarkRowAmount.description_en:
The number of watermark rows.

This parameter is not yet available for use
WatermarkRowAmount.description_zh:
水印行数。

此参数暂未开放使用

WatermarkSecurity.description_en: The security-first rule for invisible watermarks

WatermarkShadow.description_en:
Specifies whether the watermark shadow effect is enabled. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
WatermarkShadow.description_zh:
水印阴影效果开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

WatermarkTransparency.description_en: The transparency level of the watermark

WatermarkTransparencyValue.description_en: The watermark transparency. A larger value indicates lower transparency. Valid values: 10 to 100
WatermarkTransparencyValue.description_zh: 水印透明度，值越大，透明度越小。 取值范围： 10\~100

WyAssistant.description_en: Specifies whether the WUYING AI Assistant entry is provided in the cloud computer floating ball
WyAssistant.description_zh: 是否在云电脑悬浮球内提供无影AI助手功能入口

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next query. If NextToken is empty, no more results exist
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the current page for a paged query
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query.    
Default value: 20
PageSize.description_zh:
分页查询时，每页最大行数。    
默认值：20
